<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><style>html,body{margin:0}</style></head><body><title>Source-a-Thon Bib Draw</title>

<style>

:root{

  color-scheme:dark;

  --bg:#0f1a14; --panel:#16251c; --ink:#f3f1e8; --muted:#9db3a3; --accent:#f2b134; --accent-ink:#241a00;

  --line:#2a4033; --field:#0c1510; --ok:#7bd88f; --bad:#ff8b7a; --warn:#f2b134;

}

*{box-sizing:border-box}

html{background:var(--bg)}

body{background:radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 50% -10%,#1d3a2a 0,var(--bg) 60%) fixed,var(--bg);color:var(--ink);

  font:16px/1.45 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden;min-height:100%}

.screen{display:none;min-height:100%;padding:20px 16px 32px}

.screen.active{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;animation:fade .4s ease-out both}

@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

h1{font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,36px);margin:0 0 4px;letter-spacing:.3px;text-align:center}

.sub{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 22px;text-align:center}

.panel{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:20px;width:100%;max-width:600px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}

.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0}

.field>label,.field>.lbl{font-weight:600}

.row{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.row .field{flex:1 1 160px}

textarea,input[type=number]{width:100%;background:var(--field);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;font:inherit}

textarea{min-height:130px;resize:vertical;font:14px/1.4 ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace}

input[type=number]{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

textarea:focus,input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}

.hint{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:0}

.opts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}

.opts label{font-weight:400;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}

.opts input[type=range]{flex:1;min-width:0}

details{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:14px}

summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}

details[open] summary{margin-bottom:14px}

details .stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}

button{font:inherit;font-weight:700;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 20px;cursor:pointer}

.primary{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);width:100%;font-size:18px}

.primary:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(1.08)}

.primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}

.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 14px;font-weight:500}

.ghost:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--muted)}

button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:2px}

.status{font-size:14px;min-height:20px}

.ok{color:var(--ok)} .bad{color:var(--bad)} .warn{color:var(--warn)}

.stats{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

.stats b{color:var(--ink)}

.notice{border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--ok);background:var(--field);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:14px}

.notice.warnbox{border-left-color:var(--warn)}

.notice button{padding:0;background:none;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;border-radius:0}

.foot{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;text-align:center;margin-top:14px}


/* Screen 2: ready */

#ready{justify-content:center;text-align:center;gap:18px}

.count{color:var(--muted);font-size:clamp(16px,2.4vw,22px);letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase}

.source{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;max-width:46ch}

.bigbtn{width:min(86vw,520px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:0;cursor:pointer;

  background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#ffd36b,var(--accent) 45%,#c98a0f);color:var(--accent-ink);

  font-size:clamp(40px,9vw,84px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;

  box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(242,177,52,.15),0 0 80px rgba(242,177,52,.35),0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);

  transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s;animation:pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}

.bigbtn:hover{transform:scale(1.03)}

.bigbtn:active{transform:scale(.97)}

@keyframes pulse{50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 22px rgba(242,177,52,.08),0 0 110px rgba(242,177,52,.5),0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}}

.linkbtn{background:none;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;text-decoration:underline;padding:6px}

.linkbtn:hover{color:var(--ink)}


/* Screen 3: stage */

#stage{justify-content:center;text-align:center}

.stagewrap{width:100%;max-width:1100px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}

.bibframe{position:relative;width:min(94vw,calc((100vh - 280px) * 212 / 146),900px);max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:212/146;

  border-radius:16px;background:var(--field);border:3px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden;transition:box-shadow .4s,border-color .4s}

.bibframe img:not([src]){visibility:hidden}

.bibframe img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;background:#fff;display:block}

.bibframe.landed{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(242,177,52,.25),0 0 90px rgba(242,177,52,.45);animation:pop .5s ease-out}

@keyframes pop{0%{transform:scale(.96)}60%{transform:scale(1.03)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}

.result{margin-top:18px;min-height:130px;width:100%}

.round{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:3px}

.winner{font-size:clamp(32px,6vw,68px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.1;margin:6px 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

.meta{font-size:clamp(17px,2.4vw,26px);color:var(--muted)}

.meta b{color:var(--ink)}

.meta a{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none}

.meta a:hover{text-decoration:underline}

.drawing{font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,30px);color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;padding-top:34px}

.errmsg{font-size:clamp(17px,2.4vw,22px);color:var(--bad);padding-top:30px;max-width:60ch;margin:0 auto}

.fadein{animation:fade .5s ease-out both}

.actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-top:14px;min-height:56px}

.actions .primary{width:auto;min-width:220px}

.hidden{display:none !important}


/* Winners summary */

#summary{max-width:1100px;width:100%}

#summary h2{margin:6px 0 16px;text-align:center}

.wlist{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:12px;width:100%}

.wcard{background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;text-align:left}

.wcard img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:212/146;object-fit:contain;background:#fff;display:block}

.wcard div{padding:8px 12px;font-size:14px}

.wcard strong{display:block;font-size:16px}

.wcard span{color:var(--muted)}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bibframe.landed,.fadein,.bigbtn,.screen.active{animation:none}}

</style>


<!-- SCREEN 1: host setup -->

<main class="screen active" id="setup">

  <h1>🎽 Source-a-Thon Bib Draw</h1>

  <p class="sub">Host setup</p>

  <div class="panel">

    <div class="field">

      <label for="count">How many winners are we drawing?</label>

      <input type="number" id="count" min="1" max="50" step="1" value="1" inputmode="numeric">

    </div>


    <div class="field">

      <label for="ids">Ineligible WikiTree IDs</label>

      <textarea id="ids" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Smith-1234&#10;Jones-5678"></textarea>

      <p class="hint">Previous winners who have already claimed their prize. One per line or comma-separated; wikitree.com/wiki/… links work too.</p>

    </div>


    <div class="stats" id="stats" aria-live="polite"></div>


    <details id="adv">

      <summary>Draw settings</summary>

      <div class="stack">

        <div class="field">

          <span class="lbl">Pick winners from</span>

          <div class="opts" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Pick winners from">

            <label><input type="radio" name="src" id="srcTool" value="tool" checked> WikiTree random participant tool (active participants only)</label>

            <label><input type="radio" name="src" id="srcRoster" value="roster"> Entire eligible roster</label>

          </div>

          <div class="notice" id="toolNote">Checking the WikiTree tool…</div>

        </div>

        <div class="field">

          <label for="hours">Active within the last (hours)</label>

          <input type="number" id="hours" min="1" max="720" step="1" value="4" inputmode="numeric">

        </div>

        <div class="opts"><label>Spin length <input type="range" id="dur" min="3" max="20" value="8"> <span id="durv">8s</span></label></div>

      </div>

    </details>


    <button class="primary" id="toReady">Continue &rarr;</button>

    <div class="status" id="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

  </div>

  <p class="foot">Roster snapshot from the Participants sheet, Oct 2, 2026 &middot; 602 participants</p>

</main>


<!-- SCREEN 2: big draw button -->

<main class="screen" id="ready">

  <h1>Ready to draw!</h1>

  <div class="count" id="countLbl"></div>

  <div class="source" id="srcLbl"></div>

  <button class="bigbtn" id="drawBtn" aria-label="Start the draw">DRAW!</button>

  <button class="linkbtn" id="backToSetup">&larr; Back to setup</button>

</main>


<!-- SCREEN 3: spinning / winners -->

<main class="screen" id="stage">

  <div class="stagewrap" id="spinView">

    <div class="bibframe" id="frame"><img id="bib" alt=""></div>

    <div class="result" id="result" aria-live="polite"></div>

    <div class="actions" id="actions"></div>

  </div>

  <section id="summary" class="hidden">

    <h2>🏆 Winners</h2>

    <div class="wlist" id="wlist"></div>

    <div class="actions"><button class="ghost" id="backToStage">&larr; Back</button><button class="ghost" id="newDraw2">New draw</button></div>

  </section>

</main>

const BIB_URL = b => "https://www.wikitree.com/images/source-a-thon/bibs/" + b + ".png";

const IMG = b => BIBS[b] ? "data:image/webp;base64," + BIBS[b] : BIB_URL(b);

const TOOL = (hours) => "https://plus.wikitree.com/function/WTRandom/Random.htm?challenge=SourceAThon2026&hours=" + encodeURIComponent(hours);


const people = ROSTER.map(([id,name,team,bib,note]) => ({id,name,team,bib,note}));

const norm = s => s.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,"_");

const byId = new Map(people.map(p => [norm(p.id), p]));

const sheetIneligible = people.filter(p => p.note);

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]));

const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

const store = {

  get(k){ try { return localStorage.getItem("sat-draw-"+k); } catch(e){ return null; } },

  set(k,v){ try { localStorage.setItem("sat-draw-"+k, v); } catch(e){} }

};


let toolOk = false;           // can this page reach the WikiTree tool?

let cfg = null;               // settings captured when the host continues

let drawn = [], drawnSet = new Set();

let runId = 0;


function show(id){

  document.querySelectorAll(".screen").forEach(s => s.classList.toggle("active", s.id === id));

  window.scrollTo(0,0);

}


/* ---------- setup: parsing, stats, remembered values ---------- */

function parseIds(text){

  const tokens = text.split(/[\n,;\t]+/).map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(t => {

    const m = t.match(/wikitree\.com\/(?:wiki|genealogy\/[^\/]+)\/([^\s?#\/]+)/i);

    return (m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : t).trim();

  });

  const keys = new Set(), unknown = [];

  for (const t of tokens){

    const k = norm(t);

    if (keys.has(k)) continue;

    keys.add(k);

    if (!byId.has(k)) unknown.push(t);

  }

  return {keys, unknown};

}

function hostSet(){ return parseIds($("ids").value).keys; }

function isEligible(p, extra){

  const k = norm(p.id);

  return !p.note && !hostSet_cache.has(k) && !drawnSet.has(k);

}

let hostSet_cache = new Set();


function refreshStats(){

  const {keys, unknown} = parseIds($("ids").value);

  hostSet_cache = keys;

  const hostMatched = [...keys].filter(k => byId.has(k) && !byId.get(k).note).length;

  const eligible = people.filter(p => !p.note && !keys.has(norm(p.id))).length;

  $("stats").innerHTML =

    `<b>${eligible}</b> eligible of ${people.length} on the roster &middot; ${sheetIneligible.length} marked ineligible in the sheet` +

    (keys.size ? ` &middot; ${hostMatched} added by you` : "") +

    (unknown.length ? `<br><span class="bad">Not on the roster: ${unknown.map(esc).join(", ")}</span>` : "");

  $("status").textContent = "";

  return {eligible, unknown};

}

$("ids").addEventListener("input", () => { store.set("ids", $("ids").value); refreshStats(); });

$("count").addEventListener("input", () => store.set("count", $("count").value));

$("hours").addEventListener("change", () => store.set("hours", $("hours").value));

$("dur").addEventListener("input", () => { $("durv").textContent = $("dur").value + "s"; store.set("dur", $("dur").value); });

for (const k of ["ids","count","hours","dur"]){ const v = store.get(k); if (v !== null) { $(k).value = v; } }

$("durv").textContent = $("dur").value + "s";

refreshStats();


/* ---------- WikiTree random tool ---------- */

async function fetchRandomId(hours){

  let lastErr;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++){

    const ctl = new AbortController(), timer = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), 10000);

    try{

      const res = await fetch(TOOL(hours), {cache:"no-store", signal:ctl.signal});

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);

      const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await res.text(), "text/html");

      const a = doc.querySelector('h3 a[href*="/wiki/"]');

      if (!a) throw new Error("The tool did not return a participant. It may have no active participants in the last " + hours + " hours.");

      return decodeURIComponent(a.getAttribute("href").split("/wiki/")[1]);

    } catch(e){ lastErr = e; await sleep(400 * (attempt+1)); }

    finally{ clearTimeout(timer); }

  }

  throw lastErr;

}

async function probeTool(){

  $("toolNote").className = "notice"; $("toolNote").textContent = "Checking the WikiTree tool…";

  try{

    await fetchRandomId($("hours").value || 4);

    toolOk = true;

    $("srcTool").disabled = false;

    if (store.get("src") === "roster") $("srcRoster").checked = true; else $("srcTool").checked = true;

    $("toolNote").innerHTML = `✓ Connected to the WikiTree random participant tool.`;

  } catch(e){

    toolOk = false;

    $("srcTool").disabled = true; $("srcRoster").checked = true;

    $("toolNote").className = "notice warnbox";

    $("toolNote").innerHTML = `The WikiTree tool can't be reached from this page, so winners will be picked at random from the whole eligible roster, including people who haven't been active recently. <button type="button" id="recheck">Check again</button>`;

    $("recheck").onclick = probeTool;

    $("adv").open = true;

  }

}

document.querySelectorAll('input[name="src"]').forEach(r => r.addEventListener("change", () => store.set("src", r.value)));

probeTool();


async function pickWinner(){

  if (cfg.source === "roster"){

    const pool = people.filter(isEligible);

    if (!pool.length) throw new Error("There are no eligible participants left to draw.");

    return pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];

  }

  const seen = new Set(); let repeats = 0;

  while (repeats < 250){

    const id = await fetchRandomId(cfg.hours);

    const k = norm(id);

    if (seen.has(k)){ repeats++; continue; }

    seen.add(k); repeats = 0;

    const p = byId.get(k);

    if (p && isEligible(p)) return p;

  }

  throw new Error(`The tool has no more eligible participants active in the last ${cfg.hours} hours.`);

}


/* ---------- screen 1 -> 2 ---------- */

$("toReady").addEventListener("click", () => {

  const {eligible} = refreshStats();

  const count = parseInt($("count").value, 10);

  if (!(count >= 1)){ $("status").innerHTML = `<span class="bad">Enter how many winners to draw (at least 1).</span>`; $("count").focus(); return; }

  if (count > eligible){ $("status").innerHTML = `<span class="bad">Only ${eligible} participants are eligible, so ${count} winners can't be drawn.</span>`; return; }

  cfg = {

    count,

    hours: Math.max(1, parseInt($("hours").value, 10) || 4),

    source: toolOk && $("srcTool").checked ? "tool" : "roster",

    dur: +$("dur").value

  };

  $("countLbl").textContent = count === 1 ? "1 winner will be drawn" : `${count} winners will be drawn`;

  $("srcLbl").textContent = cfg.source === "tool"

    ? `From the WikiTree random participant tool, active in the last ${cfg.hours} hour${cfg.hours===1?"":"s"}.`

    : "From the whole eligible roster.";

  show("ready");

  [...people].sort(() => Math.random()-.5).slice(0,60).forEach(p => { const i = new Image(); i.src = IMG(p.bib); });

  $("drawBtn").focus();

});

$("backToSetup").addEventListener("click", () => show("setup"));

$("drawBtn").addEventListener("click", startDraw);


/* ---------- screen 3: spin ---------- */

function randPerson(except){

  let p; do { p = people[Math.floor(Math.random()*people.length)]; } while (p === except);

  return p;

}

// Cycle random bibs, slowing down; when time is up, wait for the winner and land on it.

async function spin(pickP, seconds, id){

  const frame = $("frame"), bib = $("bib");

  frame.classList.remove("landed");

  const total = seconds*1000, start = performance.now();

  let last = null;

  while (performance.now()-start < total){

    const t = (performance.now()-start)/total;

    last = randPerson(last);

    bib.src = IMG(last.bib);

    await sleep(70 + 650 * Math.pow(t, 3));

    if (id !== runId) return null;

  }

  let settled = false; pickP.then(() => settled = true);

  if (!settled){ await sleep(0); }

  while (!settled){                       // still waiting on WikiTree: keep cycling slowly

    if (id !== runId) return null;

    last = randPerson(last); bib.src = IMG(last.bib);

    await sleep(700);

  }

  const r = await pickP;

  if (id !== runId) return null;

  if (r.v){ bib.src = IMG(r.v.bib); bib.alt = `Bib ${r.v.bib}`; frame.classList.add("landed"); }

  return r;

}

function showWinner(p, label){

  $("result").innerHTML = `<div class="fadein">

    <div class="round">${esc(label)}</div>

    <div class="winner">${esc(p.name)}</div>

    <div class="meta"><b>WikiTree ID:</b> <a href="https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/${encodeURIComponent(p.id)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(p.id)}</a></div>

    <div class="meta"><b>Team:</b> ${esc(p.team)} &middot; <b>Bib</b> #${esc(p.bib)}</div>

  </div>`;

}

function setActions(html){ $("actions").innerHTML = html; }

function waitForClick(...ids){

  return new Promise(res => {

    ids.forEach(id => { const b = $(id); b.onclick = () => { ids.forEach(i => $(i).onclick = null); res(id); }; });

    $(ids[0]).focus();

  });

}


async function startDraw(){

  const myRun = ++runId;

  drawn = []; drawnSet = new Set();

  $("summary").classList.add("hidden"); $("spinView").classList.remove("hidden");

  $("frame").classList.remove("landed"); $("bib").removeAttribute("src");

  setActions(""); $("result").innerHTML = "";

  show("stage");

  await sleep(400);


  for (let i = 0; i < cfg.count; i++){

    const label = cfg.count > 1 ? `Winner ${i+1} of ${cfg.count}` : "Winner";

    let winner = null;

    while (!winner){

      setActions("");

      $("result").innerHTML = `<div class="drawing fadein">Drawing${cfg.count>1 ? " " + (i+1) + " of " + cfg.count : ""}…</div>`;

      const pickP = pickWinner().then(v => ({v}), e => ({e}));

      const r = await spin(pickP, cfg.dur, myRun);

      if (!r) return;

      if (r.v){ winner = r.v; break; }

      $("result").innerHTML = `<div class="errmsg fadein">${esc(r.e && r.e.message || "The draw could not finish.")}</div>`;

      setActions(`<button class="primary" id="retryBtn">Try again</button><button class="ghost" id="abortBtn">Back to setup</button>`);

      const choice = await waitForClick("retryBtn","abortBtn");

      if (myRun !== runId) return;

      if (choice === "abortBtn"){ runId++; show("setup"); return; }

    }

    drawn.push(winner); drawnSet.add(norm(winner.id));

    showWinner(winner, label);

    if (i < cfg.count - 1){

      setActions(`<button class="primary" id="nextBtn">Draw next winner ▶</button>`);

      await waitForClick("nextBtn");

      if (myRun !== runId) return;

    } else {

      setActions(cfg.count > 1

        ? `<button class="primary" id="allBtn">Show all winners</button><button class="ghost" id="newBtn">New draw</button>`

        : `<button class="ghost" id="newBtn">New draw</button>`);

      if ($("allBtn")) $("allBtn").onclick = openSummary;

      $("newBtn").onclick = newDraw;

    }

  }

}


/* ---------- summary / reset ---------- */

function openSummary(){

  $("wlist").innerHTML = drawn.map(p => `<div class="wcard"><img src="${IMG(p.bib)}" alt="Bib ${esc(p.bib)}"><div><strong>${esc(p.name)}</strong><span>${esc(p.id)}<br>${esc(p.team)}</span></div></div>`).join("");

  $("spinView").classList.add("hidden"); $("summary").classList.remove("hidden");

}

$("backToStage").addEventListener("click", () => { $("summary").classList.add("hidden"); $("spinView").classList.remove("hidden"); });

function newDraw(){ runId++; refreshStats(); show("setup"); }

$("newDraw2").addEventListener("click", newDraw);


document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {

  if (e.key !== " " && e.key !== "Enter") return;

  if (["TEXTAREA","BUTTON","INPUT","SUMMARY"].includes(e.target.tagName)) return;

  if ($("ready").classList.contains("active")) { e.preventDefault(); startDraw(); }

  else if ($("stage").classList.contains("active")) { const n = $("nextBtn"); if (n) { e.preventDefault(); n.click(); } }

});

</script>

</body></html>
